01

“Do We punish anyone except the ungrateful?”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 34:17).

779
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 779: 1: 4

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
779: 1:4. Sufyan said: Mujahid said,
"Do We punish anyone except the ungrateful?" (verse 17).
العربية
779: 1: 4 سفيان قال قال مجاهد يجازا أخبرنا إِلَّا الْكَفُورُ هَلْ يُعَاقَبُ إِلَّا الكفور (الآية 17) .

02

“until, when terror is removed from their hearts”

Three explanations transmitted from Masrūq (Q 34:23).

780
Explanation from Masrūq No. 780: 2: 1

Masrūq

English
Transmission wording
780: 2:1. Sufyan, from Mansur, from Abu al-Duha, from Masruq, who said:
Ibn Masud was asked about this verse "until, when terror is removed from their hearts": He said, relief was given to their hearts (verse 23).
العربية
780: 2: 1 سفيان عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى عن مسروق قال سئل بن مسعود عن هذه الآية إذا فزع عن قلوبهم قال رفه عن قلوبهم (الآية 23) .
Edition record 371482 · p. 243Link to report ↗
781
Report No. 781: 3: 2

Report 781

English
781: 3:2. Sufyan related to us, from al-Amash, from Abu al-Duha, from Masruq, from Abd Allah, the same.
العربية
781: 3: 2 حدثنا سفيان عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ مثله.
Edition record 371482 · p. 243Link to report ↗
782
Explanation from Masrūq No. 782: 4: 3

Masrūq

English
Transmission wording
782: 4:3. Sufyan, from al-Amash, from Mansur, from Abu al-Duha, from Masruq, who said:
When God speaks the revelation, the inhabitants of the heavens hear a clanging like the clanging of ⦗p. 244⦘ iron on a smooth rock, and they are terrified and fall down prostrate, thinking that it is a matter of the Hour. When relief is given to their hearts, they call out, "What did your Lord say?" They say, "The truth, and He is the Most High, the Great" (verse 23).
العربية
الإسناد

03

“whatever you spend of anything, He will replace it”

Two explanations transmitted from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr and Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 34:39).

783
Explanation from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr No. 783: 5: 6

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording
783: 5:6. Sufyan, from Amr ibn Qays al-Mulai, from al-Minhal ibn Amr, from Said ibn Jubayr, on His words
"whatever you spend of anything, He will replace it": He said, without extravagance or stinginess (verse 39).
العربية
783: 5: 6 سفيان عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ قَيْسٍ الْمُلائِيِّ عَنِ الْمِنْهَالِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ أنفقتم من شئ فهو يخلفه قَالَ فِي غَيْرِ إِسْرَافٍ وَلَا تقتير (الآية 39) .
Edition record 371483 · p. 244Link to report ↗
784
Report from Mujāhid No. 784: 6: 7

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
784: 6:7. Sufyan, from Abu Yunus, from Mujahid, who said:
Let none of you interpret this verse, "whatever you spend of anything, He will replace it," to mean being wasteful with his wealth and spending it, for provision is apportioned.
العربية
784: 6: 7 سفيان عَنْ أَبِي يُونُسَ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ لَا يَتَأَوَّلْ أَحَدُكُمْ هَذِهِ الآية أنفقتم منشئ فهو يخلفه يَعْنِي أَنْ يُسْرِفَ فِي مَالِهِ فينفقه فإن الرزق مقسوم.
Edition record 371483 · p. 244Link to report ↗
04

Verse 52

An explanation transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 34:52).

785
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās No. 785: 7: 5

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
785: 7:5. Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Taymi, from Ibn Abbas:
"And how can they attain [tanawush] ⦗p. 245⦘ from a faraway place?": He said, they ask for a return, and it is not the time for return (verse 52).
العربية
الإسناد
785: 7: 5 سفيان عن أبي أسحق عن التميمي عن بن عَبَّاسٍ وَأَنَّى
"report__pb">⦗p. 245⦘ لَهُمُ التَّنَاوُشُ مِنْ مَكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ قال يسئلون الرد وليس بحين الرد (الآية 52) .
